label: HISTORICAL DEVELOPMENT
question: Can adjusting exactly three goals within a win and within the three-plus goal path improve the R13 first or ordered three?
population: Use the two entire signed R30 league-phase populations and dates, independently. Retain the original R13 grid, first and ordered three, outcome, actual-line decision and same-fixture market. All three windows are already studied historical data. Fit on the earliest, select on the middle, and report the latest dates.
fit: On the chronological training set use actual regulation winners with at least three total goals. For the actual winning outcome use log of original probability at exactly three divided by probability at four or more as a logistic offset and the exactly-three indicator as the label. Fit one scalar shared by both winner outcomes, with binary negative log likelihood plus 8 times coefficient squared, bounds [-1.25,1.25], six decimal places. For inference redistribute only within the three-plus cells of each potential winner, retaining their original total mass and the relative weights within each subgroup. Every low-total cell and every draw cell stays unchanged.
choices: Compare original R13 and joint score ranking with half and full calibrated offset. Compare a registered full-offset third-only rule for exactly three, using the original R36 third-slot conditions with the target cells restricted to exactly three goals. A target must be from the original ranks 4–12, belong to a result represented by an original first-two score of at most two goals, and add an exactly-three case to that direction. The direction probability must be at least .30, conditional three-plus probability at least .60, and adjusted joint score probability at least half the adjusted original third. Ties keep the earlier original rank. All arms retain the original independent WDL and actual-line decision.
selection: Apply the R36 rule to the same complete chronological middle window. Require a gain in first or three with no loss in the other. Prefer first hits, then three hits, then third-only, half and full. Report all results and the selected rule on the latest dates, including changes, paired uncertainty by match date, matched market and calibration of exactly three. A non-original policy must also have a positive held date net on either score metric without losing the other to qualify for an independently frozen complete upcoming comparison. Any real-time slate is graded separately from the original display and phase evaluation.
